title: DMT laser diffraction shows the same symbols
summary: Randy Anderson tells of DMT laser diffraction shows the same symbols, about unspecified at unspecified, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: they found that everybody was seeing these same symbols when they did Shine a laser a certain way

plain: A man named Randy Anderson passes on something he heard by way of a man named Danny Jones about DMT, a powerful psychedelic drug. Anderson says that when a laser was shone a certain way, everyone who took it saw the same symbols, which would suggest the visions show something shared rather than something purely in each person's head.
